headline: Colonials Take Two Posts in Callahan's Passage; Viper Pit Wholly Warden
war_summary: Since the noon edition the line at Callahan's Passage has given way at two points: Colonials now hold two of ten strongpoints there against eight Warden, with sixty-nine events in the day, The Latch alone accounting for forty-one, the latest logged just before three o'clock. Viper Pit has gone the other way and stands wholly Warden at eight squares after losing its last post, that event timed at this dispatch's hour. Fisherman's Row is whole again, nine Colonial to none, its two waste squares re-garrisoned. Nevish Line holds at six Warden to two Colonial, with some 6,500 casualties to each side in twenty-four hours and eleven events in the past six. The Weathered Expanse reports eight Colonial to one Warden, where the day's casualty rolls are the largest of any front, and Stlican Shelf stands six Colonial, two Warden, one waste. Mooring County is eleven Warden to one Colonial. Across 436 strongpoints the Colonial banner flies over 314, the Warden over 121, and one lies waste.
